beats.brief: Open the story: in March 2021 one ship stopped 12% of world trade.
Show where the Suez Canal is: a narrow shortcut between the Mediterranean and the Red Sea.
Show how big the ship Ever Given is: 400 metres long, the length of four football pitches end to end.
Show the ship getting wedged sideways across the canal.
Show the cost: $9.6 billion of goods held up every day.
Show the queue: 369 ships waiting at both ends of the canal.
Show the detour around Africa: 3,500 nautical miles further and up to two weeks longer.
Show that it took six days to free the ship.
Close the story: one 400-metre mistake, one global lesson.
